comparison.method: Prompt-only TF-IDF word/bigram triage. Similarity is a review signal, not proof that differently worded questions test different concepts.
comparison.limitations: 123 source items could not be paired reliably with their answer marker because of PDF extraction order/layout and were excluded from similarity totals.

assessment: Use as private calibration material; do not expose or copy verbatim.
decision: Retain the validated 794-question application bank. Do not replace it with the raw 1019-question source and do not infer 225 unique gaps from the count difference.
recommendedAction: Review concept and objective coverage, then create only deduplicated, original derived questions for genuine gaps. Never publish source wording.
